evidence.summary: Nine configured application partitions cover 31 exact functions and 21,156 text bytes. The latest neutral application_7998.c owner adds one exact 4,212-byte function and 569 physical relocations; miraclebookdll.rel remains byte-identical to retail.

fn_1_7998 recovered target size and relocations only when authenticated earlier same-owner definitions fn_1_427C and fn_1_7158 were visible as ordinary static-inline bodies. Prototype-only extraction had shrunk the function by 1,284 bytes.

The exact state machine kills scene windows, animates the selected model and shared model, expires particle managers, triggers the transition effect and sound, moves the camera, and raises the completion flag; this supports a transition-update role without claiming an original symbol spelling.
